item.title: 563 | Golden Handcuffs
item.itunes:title: Golden Handcuffs
item.description:
The Minimalists speak with Peter Rollins about feeling trapped in a luxury prison, handcuffs that look like golden bracelets, everyday objects that create visual clutter, the hardest part of decluttering, and much more.

Discussed in this episode:

(0:00) Discontent is a fictional story about a false lack.

(6:22) Autumn feels trapped in her career, which offers financial security, housing, healthcare, and education benefits but little autonomy or meaning.

(23:58) What in your life looked like a golden bracelet but turned out to be a pair of handcuffs? 

(50:39) Spend an evening with Joshua Fields Millburn.

(51:14) Courtney explains how visible text on packaging, labels, and everyday objects can contribute to visual clutter, even in an otherwise minimalist home.
